automation_reference.instructions: observe active Hour_ID and Queue_ID; never duplicate dispatch, R1 success or closeout receipts

safety: Review and workflow only. Open gates require specific new physical or provider evidence.

decisions_inferred.recommendation: Reuse existing UTP/PT and PMX authorities; do not create second atlas or manufacturing runtime
Quantify Butter Bot and benign protected-conductor coupon before dependent space or home-product proofs
Hybrid insert active IC, secure element and protected batteries until appropriate printing evidence exists
decisions_inferred.basis: Function first with qualified supplier modules

decisions_inferred.recommendation: Keep Mobile/LSGO in display, analysis and owner review; physical OS/managing authority held
decisions_inferred.basis: Android/PWA source evidence is not platform-attested permission

gates.title: Local review checkout and receipt
gates.acceptance: Fresh local HEAD = reviewed provider branch; clean tracked tree; 40/40 regression; recorded SHA-256
gates.hold: do not edit promoted CGX carrier or root

gates.title: CGX host and canonical root currentness
gates.acceptance: Read exact LightSpeed local HEAD/origin/divergence and root/runtime pointers against current provider; investigate earlier unverified root-pointer correction
gates.hold: Do not presume checkout CURRENT from a previous audit

gates.title: Source authority reconciliation
gates.acceptance: Owner accepts cross references among Raphael PR6, UTP PR5 and Data PR11; no duplicate material/equation authority
gates.hold: No unapproved merge or authority promotion

gates.title: Physical material passport evidence
gates.acceptance: Populate actual values/units/uncertainties/lot/calibration for 531 measurement slots; baseline 0 filled
gates.hold: Do not invent values; missing remains null

gates.title: Equation operand resolution
gates.acceptance: Trace 172 operand requirements and seven flagged schema gaps; quantify error budgets
gates.hold: 59 screening models do not replace qualified nonlinear solver

gates.title: Directional transition qualification
gates.acceptance: Target 12 priority candidate material routes, X→Y and reverse, non-adjacent cumulative histories, process-environment and contamination tests

gates.title: Printer-1 / gas cell preparation
gates.acceptance: List actual tools/sensors and access, safe benign coupons, controlled test protocol, operator and emergency stop
gates.hold: No machine actuation or chamber pressurization from catalogue alone

gates.title: Butter Bot BB01 complete quantitative contract
gates.acceptance: Specify object mass/distance, target force and speed, joints, actuator sizing, sensors, battery and duty cycle, thermal and safety envelope, acceptance measurements
gates.hold: Hybrid MCU/motor/battery until proven as printable

gates.title: CGX phone-like device architecture
gates.acceptance: Complete display/radio/power/SoC architecture and PCB/printed RF structures, security, EMC, energy, repairability and test plan
gates.hold: No fully printed smartphone SoC claim

gates.title: SAI public/private/government/defensive hardware permissions
gates.acceptance: Local node manifest, keys, identity, onboarding, consent/security boundaries, OS/Android attestation and trusted commissioning
gates.hold: PR117 source proof != Android device-management authority or attested peer

gates.title: Eco-Grex acoustic/habitat demonstrator
gates.acceptance: Use passive material acoustic controls, before/after spectral data, species-specific welfare review and permitted test setting
gates.hold: No field fauna interaction without welfare and permission gate

gates.title: Solar Hull / Mark III/V / space ladder
gates.acceptance: Trace units/compartments, mass/power/thermal/structural/EM/RF budgets, microgravity manufacturing and independent mission/flight qualification
gates.hold: Not flight hardware, no novel EMFF/RFS proof implied

gates.title: Socie-Civil M1 and river nodes
gates.acceptance: Quantify structural/acoustic/flood service loads, local geometry and civil regulation; route to accredited engineering
gates.hold: No transport structural approval from printer catalogue

gates.title: Eco/ISRU recovered feed and post-mix chemistry
gates.acceptance: Supplier/specimen passport, separation/purity, mass balance, nonlinear phase/process model, emission controls, coupon acceptance
gates.hold: Do not replace PMX-MAT-001 with simple nonreactive mixing

gates.title: 80-product portfolio coverage and shared modules
gates.acceptance: Resolve 220 preliminary gap tickets into measurable tests, define reusable module qualification and supplier-vs-print rationale
gates.hold: 70/70 PT coverage is reference completeness, not hardware completeness

gates.title: Owner review / production / release decision
gates.acceptance: Explicit code ownership, independent safety/physical evidence, rollback/receipt and acceptance before any merge, production or publicity
gates.hold: No public claims, production commands, root promotion or unreviewed merges

evidence_caveat: Schema/test/CI are software evidence; local checkout proof must be read back after write; never treat physical tests as complete based on software.
